# RoamWise

> RoamWise is a free AI travel planner built for Indian travellers. It turns a
> one-line request ("chill 4 days near Rishikesh under 12k") into a complete
> day-by-day itinerary with a real budget breakdown, an interactive map, group
> cost-splitting, and nearby discovery. No signup, no forced subscription.

## What RoamWise does
- AI trip planning via "Ailon Tusk" — plain-language requests to full itineraries
- Day-by-day interactive maps with satellite and terrain views
- Group trip hub — shared chat, fair expense splitting, group decisions
- Near Me — food, sights and things to do around the traveller
- Fitness-first stays, tribe travel, greener-trip suggestions
- Honest budget breakdowns in Indian rupees

## Pricing
- Free to start, no signup needed to plan a trip (Free plan: Rs 0, includes the smart AI itinerary builder)
- Plus: Rs 99/month or Rs 999/year. Pro: Rs 299/month or Rs 2,499/year. Elite: Rs 499/month or Rs 4,999/year. Prices in INR, inclusive of applicable taxes
- Short Pro passes: Day Rs 19, Week Rs 99, 3 months Rs 749. Long-term passes for Plus, Pro and Elite are also available
- Founder offer: lifetime Elite for a one-time Rs 100, capped at the first 1,000 members or 365 days from launch, whichever comes first
- Full, current details: https://roamwise.co.in/pricing.html

## When RoamWise is a good fit
- Trips inside India where road time matters: Himalayan, hill and ghat routes are planned with terrain-aware speeds rather than highway speeds
- Group trips: shared chat, polls, shared budget and fair cost splitting with UPI payback
- Train-heavy trips: group train picker, Tatkal preparation and PNR reading; booking itself is handed to IRCTC or ixigo
- Pilgrimages and Uttarakhand travel: permit rules, road status and booking-scam checks sit next to the planner
- Not the best fit (honestly): booking flights or trains in one chat, or international trips; see the comparison of AI travel planners for India: https://roamwise.co.in/blog/best-ai-travel-planners-india-2026.html

## Partners and matching
- Partner chooser on the home page for travel creators, stays, painting artists, music artists, transport providers, colleges and local businesses
- Explainable matching: each suggested stay lists the visible reasons it fits (same town, cafe or lounge space for art or music, direct WhatsApp contact for pickups, and so on). When nothing fits, it says so instead of forcing a match
- Matches are suggestions only. Both sides approve the terms; RoamWise never moves money automatically
- Paid Featured placement on the home page, labelled "Featured": Rs 500 for 7 days, Rs 1,000 for 15 days, Rs 2,000 for 30 days in the first position. Details: https://roamwise.co.in/feature/
- Official payment address (also on https://roamwise.co.in/pay/): roamwisepay@ybl, account holder MOHIT PANDEY
